title: Pages under three seconds, with the evidence
summary: I took on portal page performance, used user caching to bring exchange pages consistently under about three seconds and proved it with repeatable load tests that I reported to the US head of development.
what_would_have_happened: Pages stayed slow under load, with results that were hard to reproduce.
the_call: Make the result repeatable: same scripts, same data resets, documented runs.
what_i_did: Tuned user caching, reran the load tests on clean databases and published the run details and purge scripts.
what_changed: Page times held under about three seconds run after run, and the US head of development replied 'Awesome, thanks'.

metrics.label: per page, consistently
metrics.context: load tests with thousands of transactions
